div.head: List of Post Offices in Canada, with the Names of the Postmasters ... 1860
PRINCIPAL OFFICERS OF THE POST OFFICE DEPARTMENT.
ACTING INSPECTORS:
div.p: Postmasters will correct their Lists by the Notices of Post Office Operations, with which they will be furnished from time to time; and should any Postmaster discover an error in the description of his Office, as set forth in this List, he will please notify the same to this Department.

p.hi: The Offices whose names are printed in Italics are authorized to grant and pay Money Orders.
